result.summary: Several layout and overflow problems: restaurant names and delivery times are clipped, category chips and a promo card are cut off, and overlapping text makes key info hard to read.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in Fastest near you is clipped on the right, cutting off the name 'Trattoria Piccol' and part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough padding/peek so full cards (or a clear peek of the next card) stay on-screen, and ensure names wrap or truncate with ellipsis instead of being cut mid-word.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, '25–30' overlaps the word 'delivery', making the time and fee unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row so time, delivery fee, and cuisine don’t collide—use wrapping, smaller type, or a two-line layout with proper spacing.

issues.description: Category chips on the right (Healthy and the next item) are cut off by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and allow the chip row to scroll with a visible peek of the next chip so labels aren’t clipped.

issues.description: The bottom popular card (pizza, −20%) is cropped by the tab bar so the restaurant name and details never appear.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset above the tab bar so cards can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The green promo banner’s circular decorations are cropped at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Inset the artwork or allow the banner to clip in a more intentional, balanced way so it doesn’t look broken.

issues.description: The first popular card shows a leftover/overlapping fragment like '25-3' under the delivery time, which looks like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Remove duplicate or leftover text layers so only one clean delivery-time string is shown.
